correctness.rationale: Explicit upper prefixes T_r and lower blocks B_j form a grid of (beta+1)(beta+2) states plus beta-2 intermediate empty-lower-row states. The stated vertexwise sweep table acts on grid as (p,q)->(p+1,q-1) modulo beta+1,beta+2, except one edge is subdivided by the extra chain. Those moduli are consecutive and coprime, hence grid translation is one cycle of full product order; inserting beta-2 delay states yields beta(beta+4). Independently implemented the local sequential closed-neighborhood sweep and verified every designated state/transition and primitive cycle for beta=2,3,4,5,8,13 (periods 12,21,32,45,96,221), including beta=2 empty-chain boundary. The universal proof is the transition table and coprime translation, not finite enumeration.
